decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P500 -0.2%), consistent with a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($89.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new buys were placed even though 3 slots are open, and existing positions were held through the quiet session per strategy guidance to not exit winners on neutral days.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, a pattern typical of a consolidation phase after recent gains. No major catalysts were evident in today's screened data to explain a directional move. Trading was quiet across the board, with most momentum candidates in the pool already extended (overbought RSI readings above 70), suggesting the recent rally is pausing rather than reversing.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納斯達克指數下跌0.1%，標普500指數下跌0.2%，屬於近期漲勢後常見的整理格局。今日篩選資料中並無明顯的重大消息面催化劑可解釋方向性走勢。整體交投清淡，觀察名單中多數動能股的RSI已處於超買區（高於70），顯示近期升勢可能正在喘息，而非反轉向下。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Consolidation is when a stock or index trades sideways in a narrow range after a period of gains or losses, as buyers and sellers reach a temporary balance. It often signals the market is pausing to digest recent moves before choosing its next direction, rather than reversing trend outright.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 整理（Consolidation）是指股票或指數在經歷一段漲跌後，於狹窄區間內橫盤震盪，買賣雙方力量暫時達到平衡的現象。這通常代表市場正在消化先前的走勢、尋找下一步方向，而非立即反轉趨勢。
